I found no bugs in the uncommitted changes. I read the diff and the new test file but did not run the tests, because the shell command was blocked pending approval.

- **`text/slug.py:9`:** The only change to `slugify` is the new docstring, so its behaviour is the same as before.
- **`text/slug.py:15-23`:** `unique_slug` is correct. It returns the plain slug when that is free, otherwise it tries `-2`, `-3` and so on until it finds an unused one. The loop always ends because `taken` is finite. It does not add the result to `taken`, so the caller has to do that. The docstring doesn't mention this.
- **`tests/test_slug.py`:** The tests cover the plain slug and the `-2` and `-3` cases, and the expected values match the code. They don't cover a title that already ends in `-2` (for example `"Hello 2"` colliding with `"hello-2"`). That case works correctly anyway.
